headline.family_guess: system rounded sans-serif (SF Pro Rounded / similar app-UI font)
headline.case: sentence-case, italic used on the single emphasized word (e.g. 'Opus', 'Claude.md', 'fix my repo')

caption.case: lowercase as spoken, one word revealed at a time
caption.size_rel: large, ~1/10 frame height, centered lower-middle third

layout.host_pos: centered bust shot, static camera, fills ~70% frame width, head near top third
layout.safe_zones: top ~8% and bottom ~10% kept clear of text; lower-third band (55-75% height) reserved for the black title card; word captions sit ~45-55% height, above the card
layout.caption_pos: single word, centered horizontally, vertically just above the black label card

transitions: hard cut only between host-only and host+screenshot/diagram inserts
no crossfades, no camera movement — static locked-off webcam shot throughout

themeable: accent (orange) and accent2 (gold) — can be swapped to any channel brand color pair
caption_fill/stroke — yellow-on-black is generic TikTok default, freely themeable
black label card background/text — content-specific per habit, structurally reusable as a lower-third 'chapter card'
bg wall/office is NOT themeable (real environment) — a synthetic host replacement would need its own background
